summary: Completed comprehensive testing of StrongFood Premium Foodtruck website. Backend APIs mostly functional (96.2% success rate), frontend UI loads correctly with good navigation, but critical admin authentication and inquiry form issues found.

critical_bugs.issue: Admin endpoint not properly protected - returns 200 instead of 401 when not authenticated
critical_bugs.impact: Security vulnerability - admin endpoints accessible without authentication

ui_bugs.issue: Admin login form accepts credentials but login fails - stays on login page
Event type dropdown selection fails with timeout - options not found
Calendar shows no available dates - all dates appear disabled

integration_issues.issue: Admin login flow broken - credentials admin@strongfood.ch / StrongFood2026! don't work in UI

passed_tests: Homepage loads with all sections (hero, trucks, for-whom, why-us, CTA, FAQ preview)
Navigation bar with language toggle working
Truck cards link to individual truck detail pages
Individual truck detail pages load with menu and CTA
FAQ page loads with expandable accordion (8 FAQ items)
Event organizers and private events pages load
Language toggle switches between DE and EN
All public API endpoints working (trucks, FAQs, availability)
Admin API endpoints working (when authenticated via API)
Error handling for invalid requests working
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical admin authentication issue - login form not working despite API working. Fix inquiry form event type dropdown and calendar date selection. Investigate authentication middleware protection for admin endpoints.
